categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in steel manufacturing and processing, including rebar, flat steel, angle steel, channel steel, wire rod, and other steel products. It also engages in the production and sales of structural steel, alloy steel, tool steel, and special steels. Subsidiaries cover steel structure engineering, waste resource recycling, wind power generation, lime manufacturing, and construction engineering.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include electric arc furnace steelmaking with advanced off-gas detection and dynamic combustion control, continuous casting, and rolling technologies such as universal edging for H-beams. The company invests in automation, AI applications, and green low-carbon steelmaking processes including bio-carbon usage, waste heat recovery, and carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS). It also develops intelligent heating furnace control and automated quality inspection systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diversified customer base including public infrastructure projects, electronics manufacturers, construction and civil engineering firms, and international markets. Key customers include domestic construction companies, electronics industry clients, and overseas buyers in Asia and the Americas. The company also supplies steel products for green building certifications and low-carbon product demands.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with multiple plants and logistics centers in Taoyuan, Miaoli, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. The company has significant overseas operations in Vietnam, including a steel plant and lime manufacturing. Export markets include Asia, the Americas, and other regions, with exports accounting for approximately 9% of sales revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on steelmaking, rolling, and processing. It also extends downstream through subsidiaries engaged in steel structure construction and engineering services, as well as upstream through investments in raw material recycling and energy generation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing technical capabilities, improving management efficiency, reducing production costs, and expanding domestic and international markets. R&D focuses on high-purity, high-toughness steel billets, thick high-strength steel plates, advanced rolling technologies, AI-driven smart factory development, circular economy solutions, renewable energy integration, and carbon reduction technologies such as CCUS and hydrogen energy applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of various steel products including rebar, structural steel, steel billets, and steel plates. Additional income streams include engineering contract revenues, waste recycling services, and electricity sales from wind power generation. The company also earns income from investments and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading steel manufacturer in Taiwan with a strong domestic market share in rebar and structural steel products. It faces competition from global steel producers, especially from China and emerging markets like India and Southeast Asia. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, product quality, and sustainability initiatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$60.16 billion, a slight decrease from the previous year, with net profit around NT$4.53 billion. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 40%, and continues to invest in capital expenditures and R&D. Despite global market challenges, it sustains profitability and growth through operational efficiency and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced steel products with stable and reliable performance. It leverages automation and AI to control costs and maintain profitability in volatile markets. Its commitment to sustainability, including low-carbon steel production, renewable energy use, and circular economy practices, positions it as a responsible and innovative leader in the steel industry.
